subject.title: fix(rpc): do not block startup on undetermined Contacts auth

question: Should `imsg rpc` retain Contacts authorization prompting when launched interactively, while using fail-open behavior only for headless automation?
rationale: The patch fixes a real headless startup wedge, but it reverses the deliberate RPC exception in the prior Contacts-policy change and alters existing authorization/name-resolution behavior.

options.title: Split interactive and headless policy
options.body: Use `skipIfNotDetermined` only for noninteractive/headless RPC startup and retain `requestIfNeeded` for an interactive terminal invocation.

options.title: Approve universal fail-open RPC
options.body: Accept that RPC never prompts for undetermined Contacts permission and document that callers must authorize Contacts separately before name enrichment is available.

options.title: Pause for broader RPC policy
options.body: Hold this PR until maintainers define whether RPC should ever own permission prompting versus only expose raw handles.

recommendation.title: Split interactive and headless policy
recommendation.body: Use `skipIfNotDetermined` only for noninteractive/headless RPC startup and retain `requestIfNeeded` for an interactive terminal invocation.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and scoped the existing Contacts access-policy boundary that this PR extends.
